brand.name: Los Verdiales
brand.tagline: A quiet house between stone, light and garden.

meta.title: Los Verdiales — Marbella
meta.description: Los Verdiales — a private residence in Marbella. Architecture, interiors and landscape in a single movement.

hero.headline: Los Verdiales
hero.subhead: A private residence shaped by Mediterranean light, natural materials and a quieter idea of luxury.

opening.headline: Designed to be felt before it is understood.
body: Los Verdiales is conceived as one whole — architecture, interiors and landscape in a single movement. The rooms open towards the garden. Stone, oak, brass and linen bring warmth and permanence.
The luxury is in proportion, craftsmanship and daylight. The house is deliberately calm.

wellness.headline: Wellness
wellness.body: Pool, training and relaxation spaces form a secluded wellness world at the heart of the residence — water, light and recovery behind glass.

chips.label: Pool
chips.title: Water as ritual
chips.body: An indoor pool set behind glass — turquoise stillness, soft daylight and a quieter pace within the house.

chips.label: Training
chips.title: Movement nearby
chips.body: A private training space beside the pool — strength and recovery without leaving the residence.

chips.label: Spa
chips.title: Heat and hush
chips.body: Spa and sauna complete the wellness level — a retreat for body and mind at the centre of the home.

chips.label: Relax
chips.title: Evenings without end
chips.body: Bar, wine wall, billiards and relaxed seating — a leisure room that still speaks the same material language.

nature.headline: Light, garden, and the Mediterranean air.
nature.body: Rooms open towards the garden. Sheer curtains move with the breeze. Evening settles over terrace and water — the house gathers its light as the day softens.

place.headline: Marbella
place.body: A private address on the Costa del Sol — close enough to the coast and town, quiet enough to feel removed. Mountain backdrop, Mediterranean light, and a residential rhythm.

design.headline: Stone. Oak. Bronze. Linen.
design.body: Every material chosen to become more beautiful with time. A restrained palette and carefully considered proportions establish the character of the residence before the details reveal themselves.

materials.name: Stone
materials.note: Cool mineral underfoot and on vertical planes

materials.name: Linen
materials.note: Soft textiles that filter Mediterranean light

residences.headline: Residences
residences.body: A complete private world — living, suite, leisure and wellness moving as one. Private from the very first moment.

interiors.headline: Light, proportion and a softer rhythm.
interiors.body: The main living spaces are deliberately calm. Bespoke joinery, subtle texture and warm lighting bring intimacy to the scale of the house.

contact.headline: By appointment only.
contact.body: For specifications, plans, availability and a private viewing of Los Verdiales, request the full presentation.
